vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If you mean **paying to make ChatGPT recommend your company in its regular answers**: no one can buy that. OpenAI says ads don’t influence ChatGPT’s answers, and advertisers can’t shape or alter them.

If you mean **running an ad that names your company**: businesses can apply through OpenAI’s Ads Manager, but access is limited to eligible advertisers and availability may vary. In the U.S., ads are being tested with some logged-in adults on the Free and Go plans. Ads are clearly labeled and separate from ChatGPT’s answer; buying one doesn’t guarantee it will appear in a particular conversation.

OpenAI has also said select U.S. advertisers are testing sponsored business agents. Details and eligibility may change.
